name: git-forge
description: Reads and acts on a repository's issues, pull/merge requests and releases on GitHub, GitLab, Gitea or Bitbucket.

kabmo.name: Forge
kabmo.description: Reads and acts on a repository's issues, pull/merge requests and releases on GitHub, GitLab, Gitea or Bitbucket.

token.label: API token
token.description: A GitHub or GitLab token. Optional: a public repository reads anonymously, and the server environment (GITHUB_TOKEN / GH_TOKEN / GITLAB_TOKEN) or a logged-in gh / glab is tried before this.

provider.label: Forge (auto, github, gitlab, gitea, bitbucket)
provider.description: Which API the remote speaks. `auto` reads the host name: github.com (or any host containing github) is GitHub, bitbucket.org is Bitbucket, a name containing gitea/forgejo/codeberg is Gitea, and everything else is GitLab.

apiBase.label: API base URL
apiBase.description: Overrides the derived API root, e.g. https://github.mycorp.com/api/v3. Leave empty unless the host serves its API somewhere unusual.

perPage.label: Items per section
perPage.description: How many issues, pull requests and releases one read asks for. A section that comes back full is reported as truncated.
